theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Build Wealth For Life's Big Milestones
body: Define your goals. Choose investment duration. Stay committed. Let time work its magic on your dreams.
caption: Every major life goal needs a different timeline and approach. Starting early gives your investments more time to grow. Whether it's education, retirement, home, or wedding—clarity on your goal helps shape your investment journey. #GoalBasedInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestingForFuture #LifeGoals #SmartMoney
